quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on late-game execution and spacing the floor
quotes.excerpt: My mindset was just trying to get downhill and then when they collapsed, just spray out threes.
quotes.quote: Towards the end of the game, Tyler obviously had it going. AJ had it going. I had it going, getting downhill. So my mindset was just trying to get downhill and then when they collapsed, just spray out threes and then also just continue to, you know, hit Tyler on the threes, especially in transition. They would lose their man and then they'd be so worried about stopping the paint, just throw it out and they were hitting it. So, yeah, just chemistry. We're getting better.

quotes.quote: I say just going out there, playing free and living with the results. That's my mindset right now.
